content.short: INIT Capital is a liquidity hook money market on Mantle designed to bootstrap liquidity for DeFi protocols.
content.description: INIT Capital is an innovative decentralized money market built on the Mantle network, featuring a unique 'Liquidity Hook' architecture. This design allows other DeFi protocols to integrate directly with INIT to access concentrated liquidity, streamlining the process of bootstrapping new financial applications. Users can manage siloed positions, enabling sophisticated lending strategies while maintaining precise risk control. Deeply integrated with Mantle, INIT supports high-yield strategies and serves as a core infrastructure layer for developers building complex LSDFi products.
content.meta: INIT Capital provides liquidity hooks and decentralized lending on the Mantle network. Discover INIT and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
